resources.name: PKG-Zone
resources.description: Browse the PKG-Zone app catalogue and the publisher’s HB-Store links for PS4 and PS5.

resources.name: OrbisPatches
resources.description: PS4 game-update database. Look up the title ID and the particular update needed by a resource.
resources.accessCheck: Website read successfully on 2 November 2026; interactive lookup requires JavaScript.
resources.guide: Match the installed game’s CUSA ID and the menu’s stated game update. A newer update does not establish compatibility with an older menu build.

resources.name: Garlicsaves
resources.description: PS4 and PS5 reference tools, including title-ID lookup, a filesystem browser, param.sfo viewer and sample saves.
resources.guide: Start with the title-ID lookup or the tool matching your task. Back up saves before editing them and check the title and region requirements for any sample save.
